sentences.text: If you dig a pit and throw your trash in, you have a landfill.
But dirty trash juice leaks straight down into the groundwater you drink.
So you lay a thick clay base, but it is still not enough.
So you add a thick black plastic sheet that blocks the juice.
A pipe drains the collected juice into a tank beside the pit.
Sealed this tight, trash barely rots at all once it is buried.
A 1952 newspaper dug up decades later was still readable word for word.
But trapped trash still makes gas, so a pipe carries it out.
And that flame is not waste burning, it is gas making electricity nearby.
Add a grass cap, a fence, and a few young trees.
Congratulations, you have built a landfill.
